name: bucket-foundation
description: Query the bucket.foundation research canon — feed402/0.2, free and zero-key for the caller. No wallet, no signature, no payment step on the read/cite path. Every response returns a citeable envelope (data + citation + receipt with price_usd 0).

transport.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (stateless JSON responses). Add it as a custom connector in Claude.ai or ChatGPT, or `claude mcp add --transport http bucket https://www.bucket.foundation/api/mcp`. A stdio server for offline use stays at mcp-server/bucket-mcp.py.

install.claude_ai: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector > URL https://www.bucket.foundation/api/mcp
install.chatgpt: Settings > Apps & Connectors > Advanced > Developer mode > Create > MCP server URL https://www.bucket.foundation/api/mcp, authentication None
install.claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http bucket https://www.bucket.foundation/api/mcp
install.stdio: claude mcp add --scope user --transport stdio bucket -- bash -lc "exec python3 $PWD/mcp-server/bucket-mcp.py"

tools_note: Full input schemas come from tools/list on the endpoint; this manifest names them only.
